elaine (PM): Quick sync — I'm drafting the PRD for the embeddings + rerank edge cases that came up in the customer workshop. Need to lock scope, launch criteria, and a safe rollout plan. Customer will change embedding dim from 768 -> 1024; they run cosine search + a reranker on top. What are the risky failure modes?
simon (ML Eng): Main risks: index incompatibility, changed nearest neighbors, reranker input distribution shift, and batch/KV-cache behavior during mixed-dim requests.
sam (Research): Agreed. Also watch normalization differences — some export pipelines L2-normalize, others don't. That flips cosine vs dot product behavior.
elaine (PM): Acceptance criteria idea: 1) no customer-facing correctness regressions >1% in top-10 reranked metric on their seed eval set; 2) indexes support mixed-dim read for 30 days; 3) rollout can be rolled back within 15 minutes. Thoughts?
simon (ML Eng): Nice. Add: 4) latency p99 within +20% of baseline under production batching; 5) storage cost delta documented and estimated.
maria (SRE): For rollback: we need deterministic index snapshot and automated switch. Canary must cover both small query mixes and high-QPS. 15 min rollback ok if infra ops tested.
raj (Infra): Technical constraints: our index format currently assumes fixed vector size per index shard. Options: a) support heterogenous shards (hard), b) maintain parallel indexes for new dim and route by tenant, c) runtime upcast/downcast (risky). Recommend b) for predictability.
sam (Research): Re: reranker: ensure model input embedding pipeline clearly documents expected dim + normalization. If customer swaps dim, rerank model may need retraining or a light projection layer. Suggest acceptance criteria: retrain vs projection A/B test with customer eval set.
simon (ML Eng): Edge cases to call out in PRD: - Incoming mixed-dim batch semantics: we must avoid silent padding that changes dot/cosine magnitudes. - KV cache interactions for reranker: batching across dims must not mix caches. - Approx NN fallback: ensure ANN index chooses nearest by true metric, not padded shortcuts.
elaine (PM): Launch scope proposal: Phase 1 (beta): parallel index per dataset + projection shim + opt-in routing for customer. Phase 2: native mixed-dim support and automatic migrations. Beta launch criteria: meets acceptance above, infra checklist signed, docs + migration playbook.
maria (SRE): Add runbook entries: how to detect drift (top-k overlap drop), automatic alert thresholds, post-deploy smoke tests.
raj (Infra): Implementation note: provisioning parallel index doubles storage momentarily. Add cost projection to PRD and include autoscale limits.
simon (ML Eng): Small example to include in PRD for engineers: ```python
# projection shim for 768->1024
def project(v):
    # deterministic small-rand init or PCA from seed set
    return np.concatenate([v, proj_matrix.dot(v)])
```
Keep as opt-in until validated.
sam (Research): Eval checklist for docs: - top10 overlap vs baseline - reranker NDCG delta - latency under 95th percentile QPS - synthetic mixed-dim stress test
elaine (PM): OK — I'll draft the PRD with these sections: scope, acceptance, infra options, rollout plan, customer runbook, eval checklist. @simon @raj please add short implementation estimates (dev+infra+qa). @maria please add runbook items. Target for PRD draft: EOD Friday.
simon (ML Eng): I'll give estimates by Thursday.
raj (Infra): I'll put infra numbers and storage/cost projections by Thursday as well.
maria (SRE): Adding runbook and alert thresholds today.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline triggered: prd/draft created (link: https://redwood.internal/prd/embeddings-dim-change) :rocket:
elaine (PM): Thanks all — I'll ping again when draft is up. Small follow-up: include a clear customer opt-in toggle and migration timeline in the PRD.
simon (ML Eng): One more edge case: clients embedding normalization mismatch + quantization differences can change nearest neighbor ordering even with same dim. Add unit tests that compare float32 vs quantized embeddings on seed set.
sam (Research): And include a short A/B experiment plan for reranker retrain vs projection layer. That will be the decider for GA.
elaine (PM): Perfect. Closing loop — expect PRD link in this thread later today.
